entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, and you've reached VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return these terrible shoes I bought. This is a complete ripoff and I want my money back immediately!
I can certainly look into that for you, sir. I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. To pull up your order, could I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Mark Peterson, order number 881-2945. And you're damn right I'm not happy. I've never had a worse experience.

Okay, I have your order right here for the Mountain Bike Shoes. I see they were delivered seven days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the fit?

The issue is that your so-called 'performance' cycling shoes are instruments of torture! I took them on one ride and they gave me horrible blisters on both heels. I couldn't even finish my ride! And the placement for the cleats feels totally off. This is unacceptable.
I see. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers, and I sincerely apologize for the discomfort they caused. It sounds like a sizing or fit issue.

I don't care what it is! I want a refund, and I want it now. Don't give me the runaround or I'll just dispute the charge with my credit card and leave a review on every website you can imagine. Put your manager on the phone!

I understand your frustration, Mark, and there's no need to speak with a manager. I can process this for you directly. Since you're within our 90-day return window for apparel and shoes, I can absolutely authorize a full refund for you. There will be no issue with that at all.
Wait, really? You're just going to give me the refund? No restocking fee or some other garbage excuse?

No, sir. No fees at all. We stand by our 90-day policy for items like these. I have just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending an email to you as we speak with a prepaid shipping label. Just pack the cycling shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once our warehouse receives them, your refund will be processed back to your original form of payment.
Huh. Okay. I just got the email. Well, that was... surprisingly easy. I was expecting a huge fight.
Not at all. We want to make things right. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mark?
No, that's it. This handles it. Thank you, David.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
